name: Assessed land value per acre
source: MAPC Rethinking the Retail Strip Sites (DataCommon 442)
vintage: dataset published Jan 2022; assessment year not stated in the file
computation: land_value / sitearea_a (site = one or more parcels; land_value is the sum over its parcels)
limitations: Assessed for taxation, not a transaction or acquisition price; excludes building value, demolition, relocation and holding costs. MAPC landv_pac is a municipal-level figure (one value per municipality in most cases) and is not used. Some records carry a whole parcel's value on part of it (see quality flags).

name: Buildable area
computation: MAPC field buildar_ac, used as is
limitations: MAPC method; site may be several parcels, so area is not evidence of a single owner or of contiguity

name: Average daily boardings + alightings at the nearest rated station
source: MBTA Fall 2025 rail ridership by hour, route/line and stop
computation: (5 x weekday + 2 x mean(Saturday, Sunday)) / 7 of the sum over hours, routes and directions of average_ons + average_offs; hourly averages are rounded in the source
limitations: A count of on and off movements, not of distinct riders: a round trip counts up to four times across two stations. Station-level: every site at a station gets the same value. Not MBTA's average_flow field, which is on-board load.

name: Weekday peak-hour share of boardings + alightings
computation: weekday flow in hours 07-09 and 16-18 (six hours) / all weekday flow; hours chosen as the window that best matches the Fall 2024 AM/PM peak periods (r = 0.958)
proxy_for: how concentrated weekday activity is in the peaks
limitations: Says nothing about weekends or about how even the off-peak hours are; it is not a measure of all-day demand. Station-level.

name: Jobs reachable by transit within 45 minutes (AM peak)
computation: MAPC field jobs45tr, used as is
limitations: 2018 network: predates the Green Line Extension (opened 2022), so GLX-adjacent sites are measured without it. Two Assembly sites carry 0, almost certainly missing. Used in the five-indicator setting only.

name: Straight-line distance to nearest rated station
vintage: station list as assembled for the project
computation: equirectangular approximation between the site centroid and station coordinates, nearest station among those with a Fall 2025 rating
limitations: Not a walking-network distance; centroid, not parcel edge. The baseline labelled this a "half-mile walk".

name: Overlap with non-buildable area
limitations: Applied separately from fz100_p; neither is a permitting or feasibility test

name: Overlap with FEMA 1% annual-chance flood zone
limitations: Applied separately from excl_p (each < 50, not their sum); not a permitting test

name: Average weekend-day boardings + alightings
computation: mean of Saturday and Sunday totals
limitations: Dropped as redundant with daily; see checks
